method_scope: one-round Localizer + Linker + Reviser/Generator proposal adaptation; no upstream held-out Validator, iterative rejection, or adoption
model_choice_reason: Provided gateway repeatedly returned HTTP429 for GPT-5.2; user allowed the method default model GPT-4.1.

information_boundary.verifier_access: execution harness after agent completion; no hidden verifier output fed to frozen diagnosis/repair

execution.sandbox: isolated task Docker containers on m253
execution.selected_attempt_policy: first valid complete run; retry infrastructure failure after a documented repair; no best-of-score selection
execution.normal_failed_run_policy: retain as failure; no new proposal or retry after observing a valid verifier failure

preprocessing: Representative run README adjustments recorded in prepared task manifests; no new verifier weakening.
infrastructure_changes: NET_ADMIN on isolated main container for official root-enforced agent network firewall
build-only package transport mirrors with package pins/signatures preserved
root-only project uv installer cache and TUNA index for pinned OpenHands bootstrap

invalidated_generations.implicit_output_cap_1024: excluded from final VFR; logs and costs retained as preflight overhead
invalidated_generations.max16384_named_a1_dialogue_and_bike: route normalization prevented first patch from applying; per-run invalidation marker; excluded

metrics.primary: original verifier full pass among 31 requested repaired tasks once coverage complete
metrics.valid_only_rate: full pass / healthy valid executed tasks, always paired with coverage
metrics.semantic: pinned official evaluator with cached 62 judge responses; diagnosis/repair precision, recall, F1, location accuracy, regression
metrics.time_cost: diagnosis and repair stage times/raw usage separately; execution/judge/preflight separate; cached tokens preserved when exposed
metrics.actual_gateway_money: unknown unless internal billing/price supplied; model-price estimates labeled estimates

interpretation_limits: One proposal per task even if multiple Gold defects.
Model change from original GPT-5.2 trajectory to GPT-4.1 replay prevents attributing a pass causally only to repair; no matched original-skill GPT-4.1 control.
Upstream deterministic enrichment inserted unrelated Git wording in 24/31 proposals; outputs left untouched.
Official semantic judge has 58 low-confidence warning entries; no manual adjudication has been applied.

publication.workflow: branch and PR; no direct main push
publication.include: frozen method evidence, official semantic scores, only healthy selected executor trajectories, exclusion and cost manifests
publication.credential_rule: credential values never included in repository or results
